m.s: Cut {potato} into 3cm chunks and boil in well-salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Throw in {peas} for the last minute, then drain.
Meanwhile pat {chk_thigh} dry and season well. Snap the woody ends off {asparagus}: they break naturally where they turn tough. Thinly slice {garlic}, and zest and juice {lemon}.

Heat a splash of oil in a big frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken smooth side down for 5 to 6 minutes without moving it until deep golden, then flip and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more until cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest on a plate.
In the same pan, cook the asparagus for 3 minutes, turning, until bright and just tender with a few charred spots. Set aside with the chicken.
Turn the heat to medium. Add {butter} and the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the lemon zest and juice and a splash of water, scrape up the brown bits and bubble for 30 seconds.

Roughly crush the potatoes and peas with a fork, a drizzle of oil, salt and chopped {parsley*0.5}. Slice the chicken, pile it on the potatoes with the asparagus, spoon over the lemon butter and finish with the rest of the parsley.

l: Pack the chicken over the crushed potatoes with the asparagus alongside. Microwave for 2 minutes with the lid ajar and add a squeeze of lemon. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Nothing to swap.
